summary: Accuray filed this 8-K following its October 5, 2026 board action appointing Richard A. Meier as a Class II director, term expiring at the 2026 annual meeting, and naming him to the Compensation Committee; the same 8-K also reports annual-meeting vote results and other events. Compensation comprises a $30,000 annual cash retainer, an initial 75,000-share RSU grant and a 75,000-share option at a $0.30 exercise price (the October 5, 2026 close), each vesting one-third annually, plus 50,000-share annual RSU and option grants; all vesting accelerates on a change in control.
